data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German elements bōh, meaning 'god' and man, meaning 'man'. This name was used to denote someone who was devoted to God. The name Bohman carries the meaning “God's man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bohman usually hope their child will grow to embody god's man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
